name: GPU Laplacian Scale-Space Maxima Detection
aliases: GPU Scale-Space Computation and Maxima Detection
definition: A GPU-based algorithm to compute a scale field (scale abstraction) by detecting local maxima of the Laplacian across a scale space, encoding derivative information in RGBA channels to avoid multiple passes for neighbor comparison.
summary: GPU Laplacian Scale-Space Maxima Detection identifies blob-like structures by merging scale-space diffusion and maxima detection into a single pass, avoiding full pyramid storage to solve GPU memory bottlenecks.
